abstract: In the context of escalating anthropogenic pressures on coastal ecosystems, this article employs a case study of one of China’s southeastern coastal mangrove reserves to interrogate the interplay between local communities and state authorities in natural resource governance from an ontological perspective. Through qualitative research involving 30 semi-structured interviews conducted between 2019 and 2023, we reveal how state, market, and community actors operate from fundamentally different – and often incompatible – understandings of mangroves. We trace a historical shift from a community ontology, where mangroves were perceived as socio-ecological commons buffering against flooding, to a market ontology through which mangroves were seen as barriers to marketized aquaculture development. While state intervention later curtailed market overexploitation, its regulatory, ecological ontology clashed with both the eroded community framework and the persistent market logic. Consequently, state governance, though justified by ecologically necessity, proved ontologically irreconcilable with the community’s original, relational approach. This study demonstrates that environmental governance conflicts are not merely about resource distribution but are rooted in conflicting ontologies and clashes between divergent world-making practices. It thus contributes a novel analytical lens for understanding governance conflicts in socio-ecological systems under competing state and market pressures, revealing that effective and just governance requires recognizing and navigating deep ontological divides, not just negotiating resource claims.
abstract_zh: 在沿海生态系统面临日益加剧的人为压力背景下，本文以中国东南沿海一处红树林保护区为案例，从本体论视角探讨自然资源治理中地方社区与国家权力之间的互动关系。通过2019年至2023年间开展的30次半结构化访谈的定性研究，我们揭示了国家、市场与社区行动者如何基于根本不同且往往互不相容的红树林理解方式运作。我们追溯了从社区本体论——红树林被视为抵御洪水的社会-生态共有资源——向市场本体论——红树林被视为市场化水产养殖发展的障碍——的历史转变。尽管国家干预后来遏制了市场的过度开发，但其监管性的生态本体论与已被侵蚀的社区框架及持续存在的市场逻辑均发生冲突。因此，国家治理虽以生态必要性为正当性依据，却在本体论上与社区原有的关系性路径无法调和。本研究表明，环境治理冲突不仅关乎资源分配，更根植于相互冲突的本体论及不同世界建构实践之间的碰撞。由此，本研究为理解国家与市场压力并存下社会-生态系统中的治理冲突提供了新的分析视角，揭示出有效且公正的治理不仅需要协商资源诉求，更需要识别并驾驭深层的本体论分歧。

title: The ontological dimensions of coastal mangrove reserve conflicts——insights from China
title_zh: 中国沿海红树林保护区冲突的本体论维度——来自中国的启示

abstract: Many countries have adopted different price regulations to contain pharmaceutical prices, even in markets exposed to generic competition. This column documents subtle pricing patterns in the Swedish pharmaceutical market, where consumers get full reimbursement only by buying the cheapest product (the “product of the month”) and can only purchase their prescribed medicine in the packet size specified in their prescription. While the product-of-the-month regime substantially decreased prices and expenditure per pill initially, prices per pill are 4-5 times higher in package sizes sold by monopoly producers. These firms appear to have learned to exploit quirks of the regulation to increase their market power.
abstract_zh: 许多国家已采取不同的价格监管措施来控制药品价格，即便在面临仿制药竞争的市场中也是如此。本文记录了瑞典药品市场中微妙的定价模式，在该市场中，消费者只有购买最便宜的产品（“月度产品”）才能获得全额报销，并且只能按照处方中指定的包装规格购买所开具的药品。尽管“月度产品”制度初期显著降低了价格和每片药的支出，但在垄断生产商销售的包装规格中，每片药的价格高出4至5倍。这些企业似乎已学会利用监管中的特殊之处来增强其市场支配力。
title: Competition or collusion: Entry decisions in the Swedish pharmaceutical market
title_zh: 竞争还是合谋：瑞典药品市场的进入决策

abstract: Data show that trade sanctions reduce commerce between the countries imposing them and their targets. But this bilateral success can conceal a wider failure if the sanctions induce the target to build stronger trade links elsewhere. This column uses sector-level trade data, including domestic sales, to estimate both the bilateral trade destruction and the third-country trade creation effects together. Across 22 sectors, complete sanctions usually promote trade between targets and third countries. Russia’s 2006 embargo on Georgia illustrates this fact: additional trade to third markets more than offset the estimated 57% decline in exports to Russia.
abstract_zh: 数据显示，贸易制裁减少了实施国与目标国之间的商业往来。然而，这种双边层面的成功可能掩盖了更广泛的失败，如果制裁促使目标国在其他地方建立更紧密的贸易联系。本文利用包括国内销售在内的部门级贸易数据，同时估计了双边贸易破坏效应和第三国贸易创造效应。在22个部门中，全面制裁通常促进目标国与第三国之间的贸易。俄罗斯2006年对格鲁吉亚的禁运说明了这一事实：对第三市场增加的贸易量超过了向俄罗斯出口估计下降57%的影响。
authors: Gabriel Felbermayr, Ohyun Kwon, Constantinos Syropoulos, Yoto Yotov
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为贸易制裁的第三方效应，涉及俄罗斯对格鲁吉亚的禁运，未提及中国、中国企业或中国地区，与中国研究无直接关联。
title: When trade sanctions increase the target’s trade
title_zh: 当贸易制裁增加目标国的贸易
